items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: And I'd taken him down to where, Charles Delaunay was there... they said, 'Well, we'll do all we can for him.' ... we went down to Hot Club of France together, and fortunately Charles Delaunay was there.

ctx.x: And I'd taken him down to where, Charles Delaunay was there, and other members, and they said, 'Well, we'll do all we can for him.' They found him work and everything else. And he came up to my house whenever he wanted to, and we got along nicely.
Until the 7th of December,-- they didn't lose much time, 'cause everything was arranged, they knew where everyone was,
